host.what: peak of anonymous + shared RSS (pinned memory included, mapped checkpoint pages excluded; load transients included) vs the host estimate

model.summary: baidu/ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-PT (ernie4_5_moe, qwen2_moe): 27/28 MoE layers, E=64 H=2560 I=1536, top-6; 20.38B expert + 1.44B dense params

performance.statement: not predicted: no performance model is calibrated for this backend yet; the ordering below rests on measured relative speeds, not on a time estimate

reasons: data: this plan reads 40,960 tokens of the 5,957,839 the dataset holds (0.01 passes)
experts resident on the device: 20.36 GiB estimated + 1.18 GiB headroom fits the 23.52 GiB budget
expert kernel grouped_nf4: grouped-nf4-gemm 0.49.0 (training route 'fused': auto: compute capability 8.9 is not 9.0 (a call with 1 to 16 present groups takes the dense route))
ordering, expert_kernel: grouped_nf4 before reference: e4b.train.h2h.unsloth.olmoe.5090.2026-09-19 (1.39 vs 14.88 s/step), gnf4.kernel.e2e-training-real-prose (4.50x on a 4090)

ordering, expert_residency: device before host: host residency adds a per-layer host-to-device copy in every forward and every recompute (structural; the register has no same-card resident/offload ratio)
ordering, attn_4bit: bf16 attention before NF4: NF4 attention measured 1.013x step cost for -1.34 GB (experts4bit_qlora.lora.quantize_attention_projections_4bit, audit VRAMCENSUS)

ordering, pin: pinned host homes before pageable: a pageable copy is staged through a bounce buffer (CUDA), so it is slower per byte; pinned requests round up to a power of two (grouped-nf4-gemm#71), pageable ones do not
activation policy: every decoder layer checkpointed (recomputed in backward); no MoE activations kept (keep_moe_layers is a dial the planner does not choose yet)
